rejections.establishment_code: This code is not written that way: it takes the shape of {{example}}.
rejections.code_kept: Numbered documents carry this code: it no longer changes.
rejections.default_kept: The company always keeps one default establishment: make another one the default instead.
rejections.sequence_from: This series resumes at {{next}} or above: no number is given twice.
rejections.numbering_format: Format refused: text (letters, digits, spaces, _ . / -) around {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, {EST} and one sequence only, {SEQ} or {SEQ:n} on 1 to {{max}} digits (example: FA-{YYYY}-{SEQ:5}).
rejections.format_prints_year: A series that starts again each year prints the year, {YYYY} or {YY}: otherwise the first number of a year is one already given.
rejections.format_prints_month: A series that starts again each month prints the month and the year, {MM} with {YYYY} or {YY}: otherwise the first number of a month is one already given.
rejections.choices_count: A choice field offers 1 to {{max}} choices.
rejections.choice_twice: This choice is already offered: remove one of the two.
rejections.name_required: A contact has a first or a last name: fill in one of them.
rejections.customer_merged_choose: Customer “{{number}}” was merged into “{{kept}}”: choose “{{kept}}” instead.
rejections.quantity_priced_twice: This product already has a price from this quantity: remove one of the two rows.
rejections.customer_or_group: A price list is for one customer or for one group, not both: choose one of them.
rejections.tax_twice: {{tax}} is chosen twice: remove one of the two.
rejections.tax_on_line: {{tax}} is charged on each line, not on the whole document: add it to the lines.
rejections.discount_rate_or_amount: A discount is a percentage or an amount, not both: clear one of the two.
rejections.invalid_discount: Discount refused: an amount from 0, with at most {{decimals}} decimals.
rejections.discount_above_total: The document’s discount is more than its lines come to: lower it.
rejections.line_discount_above_total: The discount is more than the line comes to: lower it.
rejections.lot_not_tracked: This product is tracked by neither lot nor serial number: leave the lot empty.
rejections.lot_code: A lot is 1 to {{max}} characters, without spaces or accents (example: L2026-03).
rejections.returned_needs_product: Only a line naming a product puts goods back in stock: choose the product, or untick the return to stock.
rejections.customer_deactivated: Customer “{{number}}” is deactivated: choose another, or reactivate it in Customers.
rejections.product_deactivated: Product “{{reference}}” is deactivated: choose another, or reactivate it in Products.
rejections.product_merged_choose: Product “{{reference}}” was merged into “{{kept}}”: choose “{{kept}}” instead.
rejections.vendor_deactivated: Vendor “{{number}}” is deactivated: choose another, or reactivate it in Vendors.
rejections.amount_too_large: The amount is more than a document can hold: lower the quantity or the price.
rejections.named_twice: This delivery note is named twice: remove one of the two.
rejections.not_an_invoice: Delivery notes are added to an invoice, never to a credit note or a deposit invoice: choose an invoice.
rejections.notes_other_party: These notes are for another customer or establishment than the invoice: choose an invoice of their customer and establishment.
rejections.notes_one_customer: An invoice is made from the notes of one customer: choose notes of the same customer.
rejections.notes_one_establishment: An invoice is made from the notes of one establishment, whose series numbers it: choose notes of the same establishment.
rejections.source_quote_or_invoice: A line delivers a quote line or an invoice line, never both: the invoice already billed what the quote offered.
rejections.line_drawn_once: This line is already on the document: change the quantity of the line already there instead.
rejections.one_source_document: A delivery note delivers one document, and these lines come from {{count}}: make one note for each.
rejections.other_lines_of_source: A note delivering “{{reference}}” carries its lines only: make another note for anything else.
rejections.customer_of_source: A note delivering “{{reference}}” goes to its customer, {{name}}.
rejections.establishment_of_source: A note delivering “{{reference}}” leaves its establishment, {{code}}.
rejections.source_product: A line taken from another document keeps its product: add another line for anything else.
rejections.source_unit: A line taken from another document counts in its unit, “{{unit}}”.
rejections.source_price: A line taken from another document keeps its price, {{price}}.
rejections.source_taxes: A line taken from another document keeps its taxes.
rejections.after_today: Date refused: today at the latest.
rejections.nothing_to_apply: Nothing to apply: the customer has no credit, or nothing is left to pay.
rejections.above_credit: The customer has only {{amount}} to their credit.
rejections.source_note_cancelled: The delivery note of this line was cancelled since: its goods are back in stock and nothing of it is left to invoice. Remove the line.
rejections.not_a_deposit: “{{reference}}” is not a deposit invoice: only a deposit is given back on another invoice.
rejections.deposit_not_issued: The deposit “{{reference}}” is given back once issued, and no longer once a credit note corrects it.
rejections.deposit_given_back: The deposit “{{reference}}” is already given back by invoice “{{invoice}}”.
rejections.deposit_on_draft: The deposit “{{reference}}” is already given back by a draft invoice: remove it from that draft first.
rejections.operations_unknown: Say what this invoice’s operations are: deliveries of goods, services, or both. A line naming no product says nothing of it.
rejections.excess_to: {{amount}} of this credit note was already paid: say whether it goes to the customer’s credit or is refunded.
rejections.deposits_beyond_quote: A quote’s deposits never go beyond it: {{amount}} net of tax is left of it.
rejections.no_operation_category: This company’s invoices state no category of operations: its country’s law asks for none.
rejections.deposit_not_given_back: A credit note gives back only the deposits the invoice it corrects gave back.
rejections.source_note_line_not_drafted: A line invoices a delivery note line only when its draft already did: an invoice of delivery notes is made from the notes.
rejections.above_uncovered: A cheque or bill covers at most what is still due and not covered by another, {{amount}}.
rejections.credit_note_no_discount: A credit note gives back its share of its invoice’s discount: it takes none of its own.
rejections.credit_note_customer: A credit note goes to the customer of the invoice it corrects.
rejections.notes_keep_customer: An invoice of delivery notes stays with their customer: remove their lines first.
rejections.notes_keep_establishment: An invoice of delivery notes stays with their establishment: remove their lines first.
rejections.only_invoice_takes_lines: Only an invoice takes the lines of other documents.
rejections.deposit_takes_no_lines: A deposit invoice takes no other document’s lines.
rejections.above_due: A payment is at most what is still due, {{amount}}.
rejections.above_creditable: A credit note gives back at most what “{{reference}}” invoiced, less its earlier credit notes: {{amount}}.
rejections.returned_credit_note_only: Only a credit note returns goods to stock.
rejections.credited_line_of_invoice: A credit note’s line gives back a line of the invoice it corrects.
rejections.deposit_gives_no_deposit: A deposit invoice gives no other deposit back.
rejections.deposit_other_customer: An invoice gives back only the deposits of its own customer.
rejections.deduction_line_shape: A line giving a deposit back counts one, with no product, lot, delivery note or discount.
rejections.deduction_line_taxes: A line giving a deposit back states what the deposit charged of each of its taxes.
rejections.above_expected: Only {{quantity}} of “{{reference}}” is still expected: a receipt brings no more than that.
rejections.expiry_needs_lot: A use-by date belongs to a lot: name the lot.
rejections.deposit_rate_or_amount: A deposit is a percentage of the quote or an amount, one of the two.
rejections.invalid_deposit_rate: Deposit refused: a percentage above 0 and below 100, with at most three decimals.
rejections.validity_days: A quote holds its price for one day at least.
rejections.quote_not_accepted: Quote “{{reference}}” is not accepted: only an accepted quote is delivered.
rejections.quote_invoiced_whole: Quote “{{reference}}” is on an invoice made from the whole quote: deliver from that invoice, or cancel that draft first.
rejections.quote_document_discount: Quote “{{reference}}” has a discount on the whole, which an invoice of some of its deliveries cannot share out exactly: invoice the whole quote, then deliver from that invoice.
rejections.quote_has_deposit: Quote “{{reference}}” has a deposit invoice, which only the invoice of the whole quote gives back: invoice the whole quote, then deliver from that invoice.
rejections.not_goods_invoice: “{{reference}}” is a credit note or a deposit invoice: only an invoice of goods is delivered.
rejections.invoice_not_issued: Invoice “{{reference}}” is not issued: a draft bills nothing yet, so deliver its goods by notes first and invoice those notes.
rejections.quote_invoiced_first: Quote “{{number}}” is already on an invoice made from the whole quote: its deposits come before it.
rejections.quote_delivered_by_notes: Quote “{{number}}” is delivered by delivery notes that are not cancelled, whose invoices give no deposit back.
rejections.quote_not_on_invoice: A quote is added to an invoice, never to a credit note or a deposit invoice: choose an invoice.
rejections.quote_other_party: This quote is for another customer or establishment than the invoice: choose an invoice of its customer and establishment.
rejections.quote_discount_own_draft: A quote with a discount on the whole is invoiced on a draft of its own: spread over the other lines of an invoice, it would move tax from one rate to another.
rejections.deposit_below_quote: A deposit is less than the quote, {{amount}} tax included.
rejections.deposit_unit_missing: A deposit line counts in the unit “{{unit}}”, which the company does not have: add it in Units.
rejections.deposit_too_small: A deposit this small comes to nothing in the currency: raise it.
rejections.deposit_still_draft: The deposit invoice drafted on {{day}} is still a draft: issue or cancel it before invoicing the quote.
rejections.lot_required: “{{reference}}” is tracked by lot or serial number: say which one.
rejections.above_on_hand: Only {{quantity}} is at this location: lower the quantity.
rejections.unknown_lot: “{{reference}}” has no lot “{{lot}}”: goods enter a lot by a receipt or a count.
rejections.serial_in_stock: Serial number “{{serial}}” of “{{reference}}” is already in stock.
rejections.vendors_off: Vendors is switched off: a receipt names no vendor.
rejections.lot_dated: Lot “{{lot}}” of “{{reference}}” expires on {{day}}: a lot has only one date.
rejections.lot_in_date: Lot “{{lot}}” of “{{reference}}” has not expired: only an expired lot is released.
rejections.serial_counted: A serial number is a single piece: count 0 or 1.
rejections.above_sold: A return gives back no more than the sale took out, {{quantity}}.
rejections.lot_of_another: Lot “{{lot}}” is not a lot of “{{reference}}”.
rejections.serial_one_piece: A serial number is a single piece: it moves one at a time, quantity 1.
rejections.same_location: The goods are already there: choose another location.
